english.note: This is the all-purpose reflexive for an action affecting the addressee.

exampleSentences.english: You have to handle these things yourself.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 je5 nei5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5

english.note: This is the all-purpose reflexive choice when the speaker is also the subject, as in “I taught myself.”

exampleSentences.english: I finally learned to take care of myself.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 hok6 sik1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose reflexive when the male antecedent is already clear.

exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zi6 gei2 zing2 faan1 fan6 bou3 gou3

english.note: This is the all-purpose reflexive choice when the antecedent is clear from context.

exampleSentences.english: When they fell, they had to get themselves back up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋跌低咗，要自己爬返起身。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 dit3 dai1 zo2 jiu3 zi6 gei2 paa4 faan1 hei2 san1

english.note: Use this as the reflexive object when the thing doing the action is also affected by it.

exampleSentences.traditional: 個程式會自己刪除自己。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 cing4 sik1 wui5 zi6 gei2 saan1 ceoi4 zi6 gei2
